spans.s: ITA-

stanaḥ, stanapiṇḍaḥ, payodharau, kucau स्तनः, स्तनपिण्डः, पयोधरौ, कुचौ.
Breast

ITA-3.16.26 stanamūlam (marma) स्तनमूलम् (मर्म)
Vulnerable location(s) on the anterior part of the chest below the nipple
Two in number (one on either side of the chest) and leads to death due to difficulty in breathing due to accumulation of kapha in the chest when injured.

ITA-3.16.27 stanarohitam (marma) स्तनरोहितम् (मर्म)
Vulnerable location(s) on the anterior part of the chest above the nipple
Two in number (one on either side of the chest) and leads to death due to cough and difficulty in breathing due to accumulation of blood in the chest when injured.
ITA-

stanyam स्तन्यम्
Breast milk
Supportive structural component of primary circulating nutrient fluid. It is composed predominantly of the basic element water and nourishes the baby.
ITA-

.27 Stanyajananam, stanyakṛt स्तन्यजननम्, स्तन्यकृत्
Galactagogue, substance promoting lactation
ITA-

stanyakṣayaḥ स्तन्यक्षयः
Diminution of breast milk
A disorder characterized by emaciated breasts/loss of shapliness of breasts; suppression of lactation; reduced lactation.
ITA-

stanyavṛddhiḥ स्तन्यवृद्धिः
Morbid increase of breast milk
A disorder characterized by fully extended/large breasts; frequent secretion of milk; pricking pain.
ITA-

stanyavaiṣamyam स्तन्यवैषम्यम्
Vitiation of breast milk
ITA-

.28 stanyaśodhanam स्तन्यशोधनम्
Breast milk purifier

ITA-9.4.47 stanyāpanayanam स्तन्यापनयनम्
Weaning
A method for the gradual withdrawal of breast feeding.

ITA-5.76.48 stambhaḥ-vamanavyāpat स्तम्भः-वमनव्यापत्
Condition of body rigidity due to faulty emetic therapy
A condition characterized by retention of flatus; stiffness of anal region; proctalgia; in which morbid dosha is eliminated only in small quantities.
ITA-

.19 stambhanam स्तम्भनम्
Inhibition of excess flow or secretions
The action of a dry, cold, and astringent substance is to increase vata and check its flow through or out of the body; it therefore has a styptic action.

ITA-5.76.12 stambhana-atiyogaḥ स्तम्भन-अतियोगः
Condition of excessive astringent therapy
A condition characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: blackish appearance; stiffness of body; upward movement of vāta; rigidity of jaw; bradycardia; nonexcretion of faeces.

ITA-5.76.11 stambhana-apacāraḥ स्तम्भन-अपचारः
Condition due to improper astringent therapy

ITA-9.1.45 stambhanam/ stambhanakarma स्तम्भनम्/स्तम्भनकर्म
Astringent therapy
One of the six types of treatment modalities: a procedure or medicine causing arrest of secretion or allowing control of bleeding.

ITA-5.76.79 stambhavirecanavyāpat स्तम्भविरेचनव्यापत्
Condition of rigidity due to faulty purgative therapy
A condition characterized by retention of flatus; stiffness of anal region; proctalgia; morbid dosha eliminated only in small quantities.
